name: NSGA-II Multi-Objective
canonical_role: Pareto ranking/selection over [rentabilidad_neta, riesgo_CVaR, latencia] of already-evaluated candidates; empty front = None (fail-honest R8).
formula: min F(x) = (-rentabilidad_neta(x), CVaR(x), latencia(x)) - NSGA-II fast non-dominated sort + crowding distance
